SPARK.title: Spark
SPARK.description: A travelling projectile that stops at walls.

EMPIRE_SPARK.title: Arcane Strike
EMPIRE_SPARK.description: Strike the living target you aim at.

BLOOD_SPARK.title: Crimson Strike
BLOOD_SPARK.description: Strike the living target you aim at.

POISON_SPARK.title: Venom Sting
POISON_SPARK.description: Strike the living target you aim at. Nature hits poison for four seconds.

BLOOD_WAVE.title: Blood Wave
BLOOD_WAVE.description: A wide travelling arc, hitting each enemy once.

POISON_WAVE.title: Poison Wave
POISON_WAVE.description: A wide travelling arc, hitting each enemy once. Nature hits poison for four seconds.

FLAME_WAVE.title: Flame Wave
FLAME_WAVE.description: A wide travelling arc, hitting each enemy once. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

CONFUSE.title: Mind Haze
CONFUSE.description: Briefly blind and disorient your target.

CAPTURE.title: Arcane Bind
CAPTURE.description: Hold a target briefly; cover breaks the tether.

EMPIRE_COMET.title: Astral Comet
EMPIRE_COMET.description: A slow projectile with an area impact.

FIRE_COMET.title: Fire Comet
FIRE_COMET.description: A slow projectile with an area impact. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

EMPIRE_PULSE.title: Arcane Repulse
EMPIRE_PULSE.description: An expanding shock ring around you.

FIREBALL.title: Fireball
FIREBALL.description: A travelling projectile that stops at walls. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

IGNITE.title: Ignite
IGNITE.description: Strike the living target you aim at. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

LIGHTNING.title: Lightning
LIGHTNING.description: Call a lightning strike at your aim.

SMITE.title: Smite
SMITE.description: Call a lightning strike at your aim.

FIRE_TWISTER.title: Cinder Vortex
FIRE_TWISTER.description: A stationary vortex dealing repeated area damage. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

FLAME_THROWER.title: Flamethrower
FLAME_THROWER.description: A short stream following your current aim. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

FLAME_SHOCK_WAVE.title: Cinder Surge
FLAME_SHOCK_WAVE.description: An expanding shock ring around you. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

BLOOD_EXPLODE.title: Crimson Rupture
BLOOD_EXPLODE.description: An area burst centred on your aim.

BLOOD_BLOCK.title: Blood Ward
BLOOD_BLOCK.description: Deflect incoming hostile projectiles for 4 seconds at level I. Higher spell power extends the duration, up to 8 seconds.

SHADOW_BOLT.title: Shadow Bolt
SHADOW_BOLT.description: A travelling projectile that stops at walls. Ender shadow hits weaken for three seconds.

SOUL_SEEKER.title: Umbral Seeker
SOUL_SEEKER.description: A projectile that follows your selected target. Ender shadow hits weaken for three seconds.

DARK_WAVE.title: Umbral Wave
DARK_WAVE.description: A wide travelling arc, hitting each enemy once. Ender shadow hits weaken for three seconds.

NIGHTFALL.title: Nightfall
NIGHTFALL.description: An area burst centred on your aim. Ender shadow hits weaken for three seconds.

SHADOW_CAGE.title: Dread Mark
SHADOW_CAGE.description: Curse a target; detonate after two seconds. Cover breaks the curse. Ender shadow hits weaken for three seconds.

SOUL_AURA.title: Umbral Veil
SOUL_AURA.description: A damaging aura that moves with you. Ender shadow hits weaken for three seconds.

THUNDER_BOLT.title: Thunder Bolt
THUNDER_BOLT.description: A travelling projectile that stops at walls.

CHAIN_LIGHTNING.title: Chain Lightning
CHAIN_LIGHTNING.description: Jump between up to five visible targets.

THUNDER_WAVE.title: Thunder Wave
THUNDER_WAVE.description: A wide travelling arc, hitting each enemy once.

STORM_CALL.title: Storm Call
STORM_CALL.description: Call repeated lightning strikes over an area.

THUNDER_PULSE.title: Thunder Pulse
THUNDER_PULSE.description: An expanding shock ring around you.

GRAVITY_BOLT.title: Rift Bolt
GRAVITY_BOLT.description: A travelling projectile that stops at walls.

GRAVITY_WELL.title: Rift Well
GRAVITY_WELL.description: Draw nearby enemies into a gravity well.

FORCE_PUSH.title: Force Push
FORCE_PUSH.description: Push the target away from you.

GRAVITY_CHOKE.title: Suspension
GRAVITY_CHOKE.description: Lift a target briefly, followed by a gentle descent.

SINGULARITY.title: Singularity
SINGULARITY.description: An area burst centred on your aim.

ECHO_BOLT.title: Echo Bolt
ECHO_BOLT.description: A travelling projectile that stops at walls.

SCULK_WAVE.title: Sculk Wave
SCULK_WAVE.description: A wide travelling arc, hitting each enemy once.

SONIC_BOOM.title: Sonic Scream
SONIC_BOOM.description: Charge for one second, then unleash a deafening, wide sonic scream over 12 blocks. Cover blocks the blast.

SOUL_SIPHON.title: Soul Siphon
SOUL_SIPHON.description: Damage a visible aimed target and restore 40% of health actually removed, capped at 2 health at level I. Healing scales with spell power.

SOUL_PRISON.title: Soul Prison
SOUL_PRISON.description: Restrain and damage your target briefly.

SHRIEKING_PULSE.title: Shrieking Pulse
SHRIEKING_PULSE.description: An expanding shock ring around you.

AMETHYST_NOVA.title: Amethyst Nova
AMETHYST_NOVA.description: An area burst centred on your aim.

ECHO_WARD.title: Echo Ward
ECHO_WARD.description: Deflect incoming hostile projectiles for 4 seconds at level I. Higher spell power extends the duration, up to 8 seconds.

SANGUINE_DRAIN.title: Sanguine Drain
SANGUINE_DRAIN.description: Damage a visible aimed target and restore 40% of health actually removed, capped at 2 health at level I. Healing scales with spell power.

BLOOD_LANCE.title: Blood Lance
BLOOD_LANCE.description: An instant piercing line through visible enemies.

EMBER_VEIL.title: Ember Veil
EMBER_VEIL.description: A damaging aura that moves with you. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

VENOM_BOLT.title: Venom Bolt
VENOM_BOLT.description: A travelling projectile that stops at walls. Nature hits poison for four seconds.

MIASMA_FIELD.title: Miasma Field
MIASMA_FIELD.description: Leave a poisonous cloud for nearly five seconds. Nature hits poison for four seconds.

WITHERING_HEX.title: Withering Hex
WITHERING_HEX.description: Inflict poison and wither on an aimed target. Nature hits poison for four seconds.

SOUL_CANNON.title: Soul Cannon
SOUL_CANNON.description: Charge for two seconds, then launch a massive echo blast. Switch away to cancel charging.

SOLAR_CATACLYSM.title: Solar Cataclysm
SOLAR_CATACLYSM.description: Charge for three seconds, mark your aim, then drop a blazing meteor. Ceilings limit its drop. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

TEMPEST_SPEAR.title: Tempest Spear
TEMPEST_SPEAR.description: Charge for 2.5 seconds, then fire a piercing storm lance. Solid cover stops the beam.

EVENT_HORIZON.title: Event Horizon
EVENT_HORIZON.description: Charge for 3.2 seconds, then pull visible enemies inward for 1.5 seconds before a crushing detonation.

DOOM.title: DOOM
DOOM.description: Grow a vast black hole. It drags visible enemies inward, devours its core, then collapses. One damaging hit per enemy. Ender shadow hits weaken for three seconds.

SANCTUARY.title: Sanctuary
SANCTUARY.description: Restore up to 12 health to yourself and eligible allies within eight blocks; cleanse poison, wither, blindness and darkness. Allies include owned pets, scoreboard teammates, and teamless players when enabled.

GLACIAL_RUPTURE.title: Glacial Rupture
GLACIAL_RUPTURE.description: Send a broad glacial front forwards, damaging and chilling each visible enemy once. Ice hits chill for two seconds and add 40 freezing ticks, capped at 240.

EVOKERS_EDICT.title: Evoker's Edict
EVOKERS_EDICT.description: Send three staggered rows of spectral fangs along your aim. Each enemy takes one full hit.

ARCANE_STEP.title: Arcane Step
ARCANE_STEP.description: Blink along your aim to a clear, loaded position. Range grows by 1 block per additional spell level, up to 12 blocks.

BLOOD_NEEDLES.title: Blood Needles
BLOOD_NEEDLES.description: Release five divergent blood needles. Damage is per projectile; projectiles stop at solid cover.

BLOOD_REAP.title: Blood Reap
BLOOD_REAP.description: Sweep a crimson crescent across a 120-degree forward arc. Each visible enemy is hit once.

CRIMSON_TETHER.title: Crimson Tether
CRIMSON_TETHER.description: Tether an aimed enemy for 3 seconds, gently pulling it and dealing three damage pulses. Cover or moving out of range breaks the link.

SANGUINE_PACT.title: Sanguine Pact
SANGUINE_PACT.description: Spend 2 health to gain 4 absorption health and Strength I for 6 seconds at level I. Requires more than 2 current health. Absorption and duration grow with spell power.

CRIMSON_HARVEST.title: Crimson Harvest
CRIMSON_HARVEST.description: Strike an aimed enemy. Deal 50% more direct damage below 35% maximum health; a killing hit restores up to 2 health at level I.

CINDER_STEP.title: Cinder Step
CINDER_STEP.description: Blink through a safe line of sight in a burst of embers. Range grows by 1 block per additional spell level.

PHOENIX_RUSH.title: Phoenix Rush
PHOENIX_RUSH.description: Launch forwards in a rising rush and hit nearby enemies in a four-block launch burst. Slow Falling protects the short descent. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

DRAGON_BREATH.title: Dragon Breath
DRAGON_BREATH.description: Exhale a broad cone of flame following your aim for 1.5 seconds. Three pulses can hit enemies that remain in the cone. Fire hits ignite for three seconds.

UMBRAL_STEP.title: Umbral Step
UMBRAL_STEP.description: Blink to a clear position and become invisible for one second. Higher levels extend blink range.

DUSK_CLEAVE.title: Dusk Cleave
DUSK_CLEAVE.description: Carve a shadow crescent across the space in front of you, weakening enemies hit by the arc. Ender shadow hits weaken for three seconds.

DREAD_EFFIGY.title: Dread Effigy
DREAD_EFFIGY.description: Place a spectral effigy at your aim for four seconds. Four pulses damage and weaken visible enemies near it. Ender shadow hits weaken for three seconds.

VEIL_OF_NIGHT.title: Veil of Night
VEIL_OF_NIGHT.description: Gain invisibility and Speed I for six seconds at level I. Spell power extends the duration, up to twelve seconds.

NIGHT_BLOOM.title: Night Bloom
NIGHT_BLOOM.description: Place a shadow trap. After a half-second arming period, an enemy within two blocks triggers one area explosion. Untriggered traps expire after four seconds. Ender shadow hits weaken for three seconds.

STORM_STEP.title: Storm Step
STORM_STEP.description: Surge forwards and upwards with lightning afterimages. Slow Falling protects the short descent.

THUNDERCLAP.title: Thunderclap
THUNDERCLAP.description: Release a broad thunder crescent and knock visible enemies away. Each target is hit once.

ARC_RICOCHET.title: Arc Ricochet
ARC_RICOCHET.description: Throw a travelling lightning orb that can ricochet between three visible enemies, hitting each once.

RIFT_BLINK.title: Rift Blink
RIFT_BLINK.description: Blink along a clear path without crossing solid cover or loading terrain. Higher levels increase its range.

ORBITAL_BLADES.title: Orbital Blades
ORBITAL_BLADES.description: Orbit three spatial blades around yourself for three seconds. Enemies can take one hit per second, up to three hits.

PRISMATIC_RUIN.title: Prismatic Ruin
PRISMATIC_RUIN.description: Merge opposing energies into a slow, broad spatial orb. It passes through enemies, hitting each once, and stops at solid cover or maximum range.

GRAVITY_STAMP.title: Gravity Stamp
GRAVITY_STAMP.description: Mark your aim for one second, then crush visible enemies with a vertical spatial impact.

SPATIAL_SHEAR.title: Spatial Shear
SPATIAL_SHEAR.description: Cut a wide crescent through nearby space, striking each visible enemy in front of you once.

WISP_LANTERN.title: Wisp Lantern
WISP_LANTERN.description: Place a soul lantern for four seconds. Four echo pulses damage visible enemies near it.

RESONANT_GUARD.title: Resonant Guard
RESONANT_GUARD.description: Gain 6 absorption health and Resistance I for five seconds at level I. Spell power improves absorption and duration.

MEMORY_FRACTURE.title: Memory Fracture
MEMORY_FRACTURE.description: Strike an aimed enemy. If it is affected by Darkness, direct damage increases by 50%; combine with Soul Prison.

THORN_LASH.title: Thorn Lash
THORN_LASH.description: Catch an aimed enemy with a thorn tether, pull it towards you and poison it. Nature hits poison for four seconds.

VIPER_FANGS.title: Viper Fangs
VIPER_FANGS.description: Release five venom fangs in a spreading fan. Each projectile can poison the enemy it hits. Nature hits poison for four seconds.

BRAMBLE_RING.title: Bramble Ring
BRAMBLE_RING.description: Expand a ring of thorns around yourself. Each visible enemy is damaged once, poisoned and briefly slowed. Nature hits poison for four seconds.

TOXIC_MOLT.title: Toxic Molt
TOXIC_MOLT.description: Shed poison and wither, restore 4 health at level I and gain Speed I for four seconds. Healing and duration scale with spell power.

SPORE_TOTEM.title: Spore Totem
SPORE_TOTEM.description: Plant a spectral spore totem for four seconds. Four pulses poison and damage visible enemies near it. Nature hits poison for four seconds.

CORROSIVE_RAIN.title: Corrosive Rain
CORROSIVE_RAIN.description: Call an acid cloud at your aim. Five falling pulses damage and poison visible enemies over four seconds. Nature hits poison for four seconds.

GORGON_GAZE.title: Gorgon Gaze
GORGON_GAZE.description: Fix visible enemies in a wide forward cone with a petrifying gaze, applying heavy slowness and weakness for two seconds at level I. Nature hits poison for four seconds.

LUMINOUS_DART.title: Luminous Dart
LUMINOUS_DART.description: Fire a quick dart of holy light. It stops at solid cover.

MENDING_LIGHT.title: Mending Light
MENDING_LIGHT.description: Restore 6 health at level I to the most injured eligible ally within eight blocks, including yourself. Requires line of sight.

BLESSING_OF_VIGOR.title: Blessing of Vigor
BLESSING_OF_VIGOR.description: Gain 4 absorption health and Speed I for six seconds at level I. Spell power increases the shield and duration.

CONSECRATION.title: Consecration
CONSECRATION.description: Place a consecrated beacon for four seconds. Each of four pulses damages enemies and restores 1 health at level I to eligible allies in its area.

RADIANT_SWEEP.title: Radiant Sweep
RADIANT_SWEEP.description: Sweep a radiant crescent through visible enemies in front of you.

PILGRIM_STEP.title: Pilgrim Step
PILGRIM_STEP.description: Move along your aim in a flash of light, stopping before obstacles. Higher levels extend the safe blink range.

ABSOLUTION.title: Absolution
ABSOLUTION.description: Cleanse poison, wither, blindness and darkness from eligible allies within eight blocks and grant brief Resistance I.

DAWN_WARD.title: Dawn Ward
DAWN_WARD.description: Deflect hostile incoming projectiles for four seconds at level I. Spell power extends the ward, up to eight seconds.

JUDGEMENT_RAY.title: Judgement Ray
JUDGEMENT_RAY.description: Charge a piercing ray of holy light, striking each visible enemy on its line once. Solid cover stops the ray.

SERAPHIC_DESCENT.title: Seraphic Descent
SERAPHIC_DESCENT.description: Mark your aim for one second, then deliver a pillar of light. It damages enemies and restores 6 health at level I to eligible allies at the impact.

RENEWAL_HYMN.title: Renewal Hymn
RENEWAL_HYMN.description: Carry a healing hymn around yourself for four seconds. Four pulses each restore 2 health at level I to eligible allies with line of sight.

FROST_NEEDLE.title: Frost Needle
FROST_NEEDLE.description: Fire a fast ice needle that chills its target and stops at solid cover. Ice hits chill for two seconds and add 40 freezing ticks, capped at 240.

ICE_SERPENT.title: Ice Serpent
ICE_SERPENT.description: Send a low, weaving ice serpent horizontally along your aim. It chills each enemy struck and stops at solid cover; it does not climb terrain. Ice hits chill for two seconds and add 40 freezing ticks.

RIME_NOVA.title: Rime Nova
RIME_NOVA.description: Expand a frozen ring around yourself, chilling and damaging each visible enemy once. Ice hits chill for two seconds and add 40 freezing ticks, capped at 240.

CRYO_LANCE.title: Cryo Lance
CRYO_LANCE.description: Fire a precise piercing ice lance through visible enemies. Solid cover blocks it. Ice hits chill for two seconds and add 40 freezing ticks, capped at 240.

FROZEN_AEGIS.title: Frozen Aegis
FROZEN_AEGIS.description: Gain 6 absorption health and Resistance I for five seconds at level I. Spell power strengthens and extends the aegis.

GLACIER_STEP.title: Glacier Step
GLACIER_STEP.description: Blink safely in a burst of snowflakes. Higher levels increase the range without allowing travel through walls.

SHATTER.title: Shatter
SHATTER.description: Strike an aimed enemy. Direct damage increases by 50% at 140 freezing ticks or Slowness III or stronger; combine with Glacial Prison or Absolute Zero. Ice hits chill for two seconds and add 40 freezing ticks.

HAILSTORM.title: Hailstorm
HAILSTORM.description: Call a hail cloud at your aim. Five pulses damage and chill visible enemies over four seconds. Ice hits chill for two seconds and add 40 freezing ticks, capped at 240.

GLACIAL_PRISON.title: Glacial Prison
GLACIAL_PRISON.description: Hold an aimed enemy in spectral ice for three seconds at level I. Cover, distance or large movement breaks the restraint.

CRYSTAL_BARRAGE.title: Crystal Barrage
CRYSTAL_BARRAGE.description: Release five divergent crystal projectiles. Damage is per projectile; their impacts chill enemies. Ice hits chill for two seconds and add 40 freezing ticks, capped at 240.

ABSOLUTE_ZERO.title: Absolute Zero
ABSOLUTE_ZERO.description: Establish a frozen domain for four seconds. Four pulses chill and freeze visible enemies in its area. Ice hits chill for two seconds and add 40 freezing ticks, capped at 240.
